parameters.content:
ZKTrustLLM-Agents L4 — Stage F/F Four-Model Intercommunication

Purpose:
This single-page n8n workflow evaluates inter-AI model communication around the local ZKTrustLLM-Agents L4 evidence artifact.

Model roles:
1. GPT-5.5 Planner Agent
2. Claude Fable 5 Evidence Critic
3. DeepSeek Recovery Agent
4. Mistral Verifier/Arbiter

Communication chain:
GPT-5.5 creates the planning/decomposition trace. Claude reviews the plan against the frozen evidence and claim boundary. DeepSeek repairs missing fields, malformed JSON, or unsafe claim language. Mistral resolves disagreement and produces the final verified classification.

Measured outcomes:
Valid JSON across all steps, final task accuracy, inter-model agreement, execution time, p95 latency, configured estimated cost, repaired steps, failed runs, and claim-boundary preservation.

Claim boundary:
This evaluates local inter-AI model communication and orchestration behaviour. It is not production O-RAN deployment validation, packet-capture network benchmarking, public-chain benchmarking, full media-plane QoE validation, or a 240-run six-variant ablation.
